rag.text:
Test: TC-2406 — Feature area - Box scope - New task creating - Creating new task with original estimate & end date mappings
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Automated
Folder: /BP/TS-67 Feature area - Box scope - New task creating
Labels: teamscheduling

Description:
Test case testing result of different value combinations of Original estimate and End date fields, on newly created task. 

For additional info, please refer to documentation [https://wiki.softwareplant.com/display/DOC/Scheduling+business+input] , point A7B

Steps:
1. Open Gantt module of boxName
   Data: TC-2406 - Feature area - Box scope - New task creating - Creating new task with original estimate & end date mappings
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed with statement "Fill your box with the first tasks

You can create them from scratch or define the scope to sync existing, e.g., projects or boards."
2. Click + button, expand Create task section
and click on Jira issue
   Expected: Create task jira window is displayed
3. Fill up field project with value projectName
Select jiraIssueType
Fill up field summary with value summaryJiraIssue
   Data: projectName: TC-2406 - Original estimate & end date mappings

jiraIssueType: Task

summaryJiraIssue: Task A
   Expected: Project field is filled up
Issue type is set to Task
Summary of an issue is filled
4. Fill up Original Estimate field with originalEstimateValue and End date field with endDateValue and click Create button
   Data: originalEstimateValue: 3d 
endDateValue: 13/Aug/2021
   Expected: Original estimate and End date values are filled up.
Task is created and visible on WBS and Gantt chart with folLowing dates:
 - Start Date: 11/Aug/2021
 - End Date: 13/Aug/2021
 - Original estimate: 3d
5. Click + button, expand Create task section
and click on Jira issue
   Expected: Create task jira window is displayed
6. Fill up field project with value projectName
Select jiraIssueType
Fill up field summary with value summaryJiraIssue
   Data: projectName: TC-2406 - Original estimate & end date mappings

jiraIssueType: Task

summaryJiraIssue: Task B
   Expected: Project field is filled up
Issue type is set to Task
Summary of an issue is filled
7. Fill up End date field with endDateValue and click Create button
   Data: endDateValue: 20/Sep/23
   Expected: End date value is filled up.
Task is created and visible on WBS and Gantt chart , start of Task is in form of "Ghost" with folLowing dates:

* Start Date: No Start Date
* End Date: 20/Sep/23
8. Click + button, expand Create task section
and click on Jira issue
   Expected: Create task jira window is displayed
9. Fill up field project with value projectName
Select jiraIssueType
Fill up field summary with value summaryJiraIssue
   Data: projectName: TC-2406 - Original estimate & end date mappings

jiraIssueType: Task

summaryJiraIssue: Task C
   Expected: Project field is filled up
Issue type is set to Task
Summary of an issue is filled
10. Fill up Original Estimate field with originalEstimateValue and click Create button
   Data: originalEstimateValue: 6d
   Expected: Task is created and it is visible on WBS, 
Original estimate : 1w 1d
Task bar is not visible on Gantt Chart
11. Click on End Date on Gantt WBS for task with taskSummary and select newEndDate
   Data: taskSummary: OriginalEstimatePresent
newEndDate: 15/Sep/23
   Expected: Task became visible on Gantt chart with falLowing details:

* Start Date: 08/Sep/23
* End Date: 15/Sep/23
* Original estimate: 1w 1d
12. Click + button, expand Create task section
and click on Jira issue
   Expected: Create task jira window is displayed
13. Fill up field project with value projectName
Select jiraIssueType
Fill up field summary with value summaryJiraIssue
   Data: projectName: TC-2406 - Original estimate & end date mappings

jiraIssueType: Task

summaryJiraIssue: Task D
   Expected: Project field is filled up
Issue type is set to Task
Summary of an issue is filled
14. Click Create button
   Expected: Task is created and it is visible on WBS, 
Task bar is not visible on Gantt Chart
